private_authority_layer.public_output_policy: Candidate records, IDs, private notes, and registry paths must not appear in static output or public exports.

release_delta_from_v0_1_1.summary: Completes the first authority-loop content milestone, the bounded Phase 55E evidence expansion, the Phase 55F publication review, the Phase 55G Project Baccara authority conversion, and the Phase 55H Toronto pre-decision authority gate with 16 Published signals, a public update log, and versioned source, topic, and Published-signal exports.

seo_policy.robots: Allow all public routes and reference https://ftfn.io/sitemap.xml
seo_policy.sitemap: Include primary public pages, Atlas reference pages, local systems, dependency maps, and Published signal details only

release_gates: Run all predeploy commands from app/
Confirm 229 generated HTML pages and all required outputs
Confirm all 16 Published signal URLs are present in the sitemap
Confirm every non-published signal URL is absent from the sitemap
Confirm Published details use index, follow and non-published details use noindex, follow
Confirm canonical URLs and robots output use https://ftfn.io
Confirm all 30 sources supporting Published signals were checked on or after 2026-07-22
Confirm all three public JSON exports match the versioned allowlist contract
Confirm the local candidate registry contains exactly 150 unique records and remains Git-ignored
Confirm generated output contains no private candidate IDs or registry-path references
Confirm the ten-entry public update log renders
Run desktop and mobile browser QA on the ten core reader journeys
Deploy to a preview URL only after explicit approval
Attach ftfn.io only after preview checks pass and explicit approval is recorded
known_limitations: The package version remains 0.2.0-dev until an approved preview and release decision.
The hosted Sites URL is owner-only and has not been made public or attached to ftfn.io.
Twenty signals, one briefing, two dependency maps, and local-system constraint profiles remain non-published or prelaunch material.
The public JSON files are static build exports, not a live API or database-backed service.
The 150-record candidate registry is an ignored local file and requires private backup outside public Git.
The optional bulk candidate-link audit was blocked by uniform outbound Node network failures in the verification environment; every candidate still requires live human confirmation before promotion.

The Project Baccara record now includes an official 4-1 County action and final active air permit, but it does not prove the fully executed MCP, condition compliance, service, construction, occupancy, or operation.

The Toronto application 24 254930 record is scheduled for City Council on July 29-31, 2026; no Council disposition, enacted by-law, permit, start, completion, or occupancy is claimed before that meeting.
Supabase activation, automated monitoring, analytics, accounts, and public alerting are separate later decisions.
notes: This manifest records the local Phase 55H Toronto pre-decision authority repair while the owner-only preview still serves Sites version 5 from commit ddeea6ab3213d7e9367c6564a9b8d31395ba7675. The package now records the July 29-31 Council gate, bill-withholding conditions, and bounded negative permit searches; the signal remains In Review. Access remains custom with one allowed owner and no groups. The ftfn.io and www.ftfn.io custom-domain entries remain pending DNS validation and do not route to the Site. This manifest does not authorize public access, DNS changes, or package freeze.
